Dear Kalinga,

Good day, Kalinga! I hope that you and everyone in your organization are doing well. I am happy to write to you again and to thank you for your kindness. I am thankful that I can write to you again and tell you how I am doing. I am writing to share what happened to me this month.

For this month, we finished our first quarter examinations. I am currently in Grade 11 under the HUMSS strand. I received 82 in Disciplines and Ideas in the Social Sciences and 81 in Philippine Politics. My general average is around 83. We also started working on our research paper, and the deadline for the first part is next month. I have not yet received my grade in Creative Writing because the results have not been released. I keep a notebook for important dates and deadlines so that I will not forget them. I would like to study more often, but I am still adjusting my routine.

My father is a fisherman in Marikina, and my mother is a saleslady in a mall. My younger sister is in Grade 3, and I help her with her homework in the evenings. The situation of our family is the same as in the previous month.

Our requirements this month needed several printed documents, so I had to spend part of my allowance on printing and transportation. I asked my parents for help, and I was able to submit everything by the deadline.

Thank you again for your trust and for the scholarship that you have given me. I will not forget your kindness, and I will use this opportunity well. It is a big blessing to be part of your scholarship program. God bless you and your family always.

Your scholar,
Adrian D. Bautista
